name: TeamKitEquipmentIssueTracker
tagline: Run the whole kit room – stock by size, issue and return, squad numbers, replacement requests and kit-day checklists – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete kit-room app for clubs, academies, colleges and schools. Kit managers see stock on hand in every size, issue kit to one player or a whole squad with sizes pre-filled from each player's size profile, track loans, trial boots and matchday kit back into the kit room, keep squad numbers unique, run replacement requests with per-season limits and pack the skips for every fixture with a kit-day checklist – with alerts and KPIs driven by configurable rules. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped on a canvas screen, model-driven form or Power Pages page.
features: Item × size stock matrix with reorder levels, receive and recount
Issue kit to one player or a whole squad with sizes from each player's size profile
Stock check and size-mismatch warning before issuing
Loans and trials with due-back dates and overdue alerts
Replacement-request board with per-season limits and one-step fulfil from stock
Kit-day checklist per fixture with template, missing items and matchday kit return
Leaver kit recovery and lost/damaged write-off with reasons
Reorder list export and stock value
Search, filters, grouping, bulk status, CSV export, delete with undo
Phone layout with bottom navigation; keyboard and screen-reader support
controlType: standard (data-set control + Power Pages field control from one src/app)
